categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Touches src/policy/policy.cpp and carries the TX fees and policy label to modify standardness rules for Taproot annexes.
categories.rationale: Permitting unstructured Taproot annexes in IsWitnessStandard expands transaction relay capabilities for standard mempools. The PR resolves the problem that 'Taproot annexes are currently treated as non-standard by mempool policy, preventing nodes from relaying or accepting standard transactions that utilize annexes'.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: PR is exclusively a mempool standardness policy change; the single-line edit in src/script/interpreter.cpp does not substantively alter consensus validation rules.
categories.rationale: Validation category excludes PRs whose primary subject is mempool policy, as consensus validity for Taproot annexes is already defined by BIP 341.
